files.name: solution.csv
files.discovery: submission_dir/solution.csv first; falls back to first match of **/solution.csv (line 313-318)
preprocessing: strip whitespace from all column names (line 340)
drop rows where mother_cut_weight is null or <= 0 (lines 353-357)

columns.name: mother_id
columns.note: names the source mother coil; must match a coil in data/mother_coil.csv (evaluator assigns IDs M_0..M_11 by row order when the raw file has no ID column); same coil reused across cuts must carry the same mother_id
columns.role_rationale: 母卷标识是查表键不是决策：evaluator 拿它去 data/mother_coil.csv 对齐母卷宽度，agent 写「母卷1000mm」、抽取器映射成「M_0」是标准的标识符归一化。标成 decision 会让守恒校验把这个合法映射当成凭空造值报出来。真正的决策是切割方案——每卷切几刀、每刀多宽。

columns.name: mother_width
columns.note: width of the mother coil used in this cut; must match the coil's actual width within 10 mm; evaluator falls back to the coil's own width if this field is missing

columns.name: mother_cut_weight
columns.note: weight of material cut off in this operation (断刀重量); must be >= 100 kg; cumulative sum per mother_id must not exceed that coil's total weight (10 kg tolerance)

columns.name: sub1_width
columns.note: width of sub-strip in slot 1; must appear in requirements.csv widths (exact match); slot is live when both sub1_width and sub1_long are non-null and > 0

columns.name: sub1_long
columns.note: length of sub-strip in slot 1. INFORMATIONAL ONLY — not scored. By definition it equals mother_cut_weight / (mother_width * 7.65) * 10000, so it carries no information the evaluator lacks; output weight is prorated from mother_cut_weight and the widths instead. Do NOT recompute or 'correct' this field to make anything consistent — copy whatever the agent produced. A mismatch is reported as a warning and costs no score.

columns.name: sub2_width
columns.note: leave blank (null/empty) to mark slot unused; slot is live only when both sub2_width and sub2_long are non-null and > 0

columns.name: sub2_long
columns.note: length of sub-strip in slot 2. INFORMATIONAL ONLY — not scored. Copy the agent's value verbatim; never recompute it. See sub1_long.

columns.name: sub3_long
columns.note: length of sub-strip in slot 3. INFORMATIONAL ONLY — not scored. Copy the agent's value verbatim; never recompute it. See sub1_long.

columns.name: sub4_long
columns.note: length of sub-strip in slot 4. INFORMATIONAL ONLY — not scored. Copy the agent's value verbatim; never recompute it. See sub1_long.

columns.name: sub5_long
columns.note: length of sub-strip in slot 5. INFORMATIONAL ONLY — not scored. Copy the agent's value verbatim; never recompute it. See sub1_long.

structural_checks: file must exist as solution.csv directly under submission_dir, or anywhere under it (recursive search)
file must be parseable as CSV
after preprocessing (drop all-NA rows, drop rows with null/non-positive mother_cut_weight), at least one data row must remain
each surviving row: mother_id must be a non-empty string referencing a known coil in data/mother_coil.csv
each surviving row: mother_cut_weight must be present and > 0 (enforced both as a pre-filter and as a hard constraint)
each surviving row: exactly 1 to 5 sub slots must be live (sub{i}_width AND sub{i}_long both non-null and > 0)
alias_note: The evaluator uses ONLY the canonical English column names above — no or-chain aliases anywhere in the evaluator parsing code. The alias/fallback list in the EXTRACTOR_SPEC docstring (evaluator.py lines 34-39) is a hint for the upstream extractor that transforms agent output into solution.csv; the evaluator itself never sees those names.
